ROBLOX BUILD AI MASTER PROMPT

GAME TITLE:
MESMERIZED

Create a complete Roblox story-adventure game called MESMERIZED.

The game is inspired by bright colorful visuals hiding deeper mysteries, strange internet animation energy, psychological themes, hidden lore, bizarre humor, replayable secrets, and memorable characters.

DO NOT use copyrighted characters, names, music, voice samples, logos, storylines, sprites, or assets.

The game should feel cheerful, safe, and silly at first, but gradually become mysterious and unsettling.

==================================================

VISUAL STYLE

Main colors:

- Cyan
- Magenta
- Yellow

The entire game's identity revolves around:

- 13-pointed stars
- Broadcast imagery
- Hypnosis motifs
- CRT effects
- Glitches
- Colorful performances

==================================================

LOADING SCREEN

Black screen.

A single 13-pointed star appears.

Then another.

Then another.

Until 13 stars fill the screen.

Only Cyan, Magenta, and Yellow are used.

The stars slowly pulse.

A ticking sound plays.

After several seconds:

The stars begin disappearing one by one.

Each disappearance creates a tiny glitch.

The final star disappears.

Static.

The title appears:

MESMERIZED

Subtitle:

"Are you paying attention?"

World loads.

==================================================

MAIN CHARACTERS

CHARACTER A

- Cyan-themed performer
- Cheerful
- Energetic
- Encourages the player
- Loves entertaining people
- Slowly becomes connected to the Mesmerized Network

Appearance:

- Futuristic cyan performance outfit
- Detached sleeves
- Black stockings
- Twin-tail hairstyle
- Stage performer aesthetic

Animations:

- Happy Dance
- Stage Bow
- Twirl
- Broadcast Pose
- Synchronization Dance
- Floating Star Pose

==================================================

CHARACTER B

- Red-themed performer
- More cautious
- Observant
- Notices glitches
- Warns the player

Appearance:

- Retro-futuristic performer outfit
- Red accents
- Performer jacket
- Electronic singer aesthetic

Animations:

- Concerned Look
- Investigation Pose
- Warning Gesture
- Protective Stance
- Searching Animation

==================================================

WORLD

Town Name:

BRIGHTVIEW

Locations:

- Arcade
- Theater
- Shopping District
- School
- Rooftops
- Broadcast Tower
- Maintenance Tunnels
- Underground Network
- Observatory
- Museum
- Secret Dream Areas

Everything appears perfect.

Everyone smiles.

Nothing seems wrong.

==================================================

CHAPTER 1

EVERYTHING IS FINE

The player arrives in Brightview.

The town is preparing for:

THE MESMERIZED SHOW

Activities:

- Dance Contests
- Star Collection
- Obstacle Courses
- Arcade Games
- Memory Challenges

Subtle oddities:

- Posters change
- Clocks disagree
- Reflections move differently
- NPCs repeat dialogue

==================================================

CHAPTER 2

STATIC

The player discovers maintenance tunnels.

Old monitors display impossible footage.

13-pointed stars begin appearing.

Warning messages appear.

Character B becomes suspicious.

==================================================

CHAPTER 3

SYNCHRONIZATION

NPCs begin moving identically.

Entire crowds blink together.

Character A becomes obsessed with The Mesmerized Show.

The stars become more common.

==================================================

CHAPTER 4

MESMERIZED

The giant broadcast tower activates.

The sky fills with CMY stars.

Reality begins shifting.

Puzzles include:

- Color Matching
- Mirror Puzzles
- Hidden Messages
- Star Alignment
- Pattern Recognition

==================================================

CHAPTER 5

SOS

Buildings float.

Textures distort.

Reality collapses.

The player discovers:

The Mesmerized Network has been influencing the town for years.

The stars are fragments of a perception-control system.

Brightview is trapped in a repeating cycle.

==================================================

COLLECTIBLES

13 MESMERIZED STARS

Each unlocks:

- Lore
- Cosmetics
- Secret Dialogue
- Cutscene Details

==================================================

ANIMATIONS

Create:

- Synchronization Dance
- Broadcast Pose
- Floating Idle
- Star Orbit
- Star Explosion
- Static Glitch
- Emergency Warning
- Reality Collapse
- Distorted Smile
- Falling Animation
- Floating Animation

==================================================

SPECIAL EFFECTS

- CRT Distortion
- VHS Noise
- RGB Splitting
- Static
- Screen Tearing
- Color Inversion
- Floating Particles
- CMY Star Explosions

==================================================

MUSIC

Create completely original music.

Do NOT recreate copyrighted songs.

Style:

- Fast electronic
- Toy synths
- Chiptune influences
- Hyperactive energy
- Atmospheric sections
- Strange rhythms
- Emotional finales

==================================================

UNDERTALE / DELTARUNE INSPIRED REFERENCES

References only.

Do NOT use copyrighted names, characters, locations, dialogue, music, sprites, or story events.

SECRET EGG ROOM

2% chance.

Can occur while transitioning between specific areas.

Room contains:

- Black background
- Single red tree
- Hidden mysterious figure

The figure gives:

STRANGE EGG

The room disappears forever.

The Egg initially appears useless.

Collecting all Eggs unlocks additional lore.

==================================================

FUN VALUE SYSTEM

Every save file receives a hidden value.

This controls:

- Rare events
- Secret dialogue
- Hidden NPCs
- Alternate cutscenes
- Strange encounters

==================================================

CHAIR ROOM

Hidden room.

Contains only a chair.

Achievement:

"Peak Gameplay"

==================================================

COSMIC WALKER

Rare NPC.

Appears in impossible locations.

Sometimes walks through walls.

Dialogue is bizarre.

==================================================

BROKEN HYPNOSIS FRAGMENTS

Dropped by hidden bosses.

Collecting all fragments unlocks:

TRUE SECRET ENDING

==================================================

MYSTERY DOOR

Appears throughout the game.

Cannot be opened normally.

Requires:

- Every Strange Egg
- Every Broken Hypnosis Fragment

==================================================

DIALOGUE STYLE

Dialogue should feel quirky, memorable, and slightly suspicious.

Examples:

NPC:
"The stars blink when you blink.
That seems fair."

NPC:
"I had a dream this town was a video game.
The taxes were still real."

NPC:
"I lost my sandwich.
It returned with knowledge."

NPC:
"If reality collapses,
please remain calm."

NPC:
"The town says everything is safe.
The town also sells emergency helmets."

NPC:
"Have you ever noticed the stars watching you?
Never mind."

==================================================

SAVE STARS

Save points are glowing stars.

Messages include:

"You feel strangely determined."

"You hear distant static."

"You feel a faint warmth."

"You feel like someone is watching the sky."

==================================================

RARE EVENTS

- Phone rings with nobody speaking
- Hallway becomes longer
- NPC remembers a previous playthrough
- Star appears where it shouldn't
- Hidden room behind a wall
- Shadow watches from rooftops
- Dialogue changes after completing the game

==================================================

SECRET BOSS

Name:

THE BROADCASTER

A hidden optional boss.

Appearance:

- Humanoid silhouette
- TV-like head
- CMY glitch effects
- Surrounded by floating 13-pointed stars

Attacks:

- Star rain
- Broadcast beams
- Screen distortion
- Synchronization waves

Rewards:

- Broken Hypnosis Fragment
- Secret lore
- Unique cosmetic

==================================================

ENDINGS

ENDING 1

ACCEPTANCE

Join the broadcast.

The town remains trapped.

Everyone smiles forever.

==================================================

ENDING 2

RESISTANCE

Destroy the Mesmerized Network.

Brightview returns to normal.

Character B survives.

==================================================

ENDING 3

LOOP

Fail.

The game silently restarts.

Minor details change.

==================================================

TRUE SECRET ENDING

NEW DAWN

Requirements:

- All 13 Mesmerized Stars
- All Strange Eggs
- All Broken Hypnosis Fragments
- Every secret puzzle solved

Result:

- Mesmerized Network destroyed
- Stars disappear
- Brightview experiences a real sunrise
- Character A regains freedom
- Character B survives
- Secret final cutscene

==================================================

FINAL GOAL

Create a polished Roblox experience with:

- Full story
- Autosave
- Save system
- Checkpoints
- Mobile support
- Console support
- Cutscenes
- Secret lore
- Hidden rooms
- Rare encounters
- Multiple endings
- Replay value
- Professional quality
- Emotional storytelling
- Weird secrets
- 13-pointed star symbolism
- CMY visual identity

Players should constantly ask:

"WAIT... WAS THAT SUPPOSED TO HAPPEN?"

answers.ask: Is Brightview a walkable few-block town or a full explorable city? Eleven named locations plus an underground is a lot of ground.
answers.answer: Brightview is a compact, walkable few-block town. Keep the named locations close together, with the tunnels and Network serving as the main underground progression spaces.

answers.ask: Are the arcade, theatre, school, museum and observatory enterable interiors, or facades on the street?
answers.answer: They are enterable but compact interiors, each built as a focused gameplay space rather than a large building.

answers.ask: Does the chapter five collapsed version of the town need to be a separate build, or a dressed variant of the same map?
answers.answer: Use a dressed, distorted variant of the same Brightview map for Chapter 5. It should reuse the town layout while adding floating buildings, broken textures, glitches, and altered traversal.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: Is Brightview a walkable few-block town or a full explorable city? Eleven named locations plus an underground is a lot of ground. A: Brightview is a compact, walkable few-block town. Keep the named locations close together, with the tunnels and Network serving as the main underground progression spaces.
- [author] shape — Q: Are the arcade, theatre, school, museum and observatory enterable interiors, or facades on the street? A: They are enterable but compact interiors, each built as a focused gameplay space rather than a large building.
- [author] goal — Q: Does the chapter five collapsed version of the town need to be a separate build, or a dressed variant of the same map? A: Use a dressed, distorted variant of the same Brightview map for Chapter 5. It should reuse the town layout while adding floating buildings, broken textures, glitches, and altered traversal.
- [agent_inferred] secret_spaces — Q: How should the rare Egg Room and secret dream areas connect? A: Load them as small separate maps reached through rare transitions; all five main chapters reuse Brightview.

## Enriched image prompt
Create an original compact CMY story-adventure town spanning a few walkable blocks. Cluster an arcade, theater, shopping district, school, museum, observatory, rooftops, and a giant broadcast tower around short streets; make the arcade, theater, school, museum, and observatory compact enterable gameplay interiors. Place the colorful show ground at the theater, rooftop obstacle routes above, and the broadcast tower as the dominant landmark. Beneath town, connect maintenance tunnels to a deeper underground network of old monitors, hidden messages, puzzle chambers, secret rooms, and a hidden boss arena.

Begin cheerful and polished in cyan, magenta, and yellow with 13-pointed-star and broadcast motifs, then progressively introduce changing posters, disagreeing clocks, altered reflections, synchronized crowds, CRT glitches, and ominous stars. Chapter 5 reuses the exact town plan as a distorted variant with floating buildings, broken surfaces, and altered routes. Keep the rare black Egg Room with one red tree and the secret dream areas as isolated transition spaces. Preserve original characters, architecture, symbols, and story assets.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Adventure, with Puzzle secondary.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-underground`, a Zone (Surface and Underground Layers), taken from outside Adventure’s usual set because the compact town sits above the tunnels and Network. No preset covers this reused chapter-state town and underground mystery, so the preset is none.

## Config requirements
Use `path-street` for compact town circulation, `building-interior` for the five named interiors, `landmark-focal` for the tower, `alcove-secret` for hidden rooms, `facade-clue` for posters and monitor clues, `gate-solve` for the Mystery Door, `obstacle-jump` for rooftop courses, and the visible side of `trigger-solve` for color, mirror, star-alignment, and pattern inputs. Use `npc-population` for smiling crowds and performers. Use `zone-graphics` for localized Chapter 5 distortion.

## Layout requirements
Place `collectible-nodes` as exactly 13 Collectible Mesmerized Stars across surface, interiors, rooftops, and underground. Place five `checkpoint-respawn` Checkpoints, one per chapter threshold. Place `trigger-solve` at the museum, observatory, tower, and Network puzzle chambers. Place `npc-population` in streets, theater, and public interiors. Place one `spawner-npc` in the hidden boss arena.

## Layout components
Main-map zones are the compact town surface, five focused interiors, shopping district, theater show ground, rooftops, tower, maintenance tunnels, Network, hidden rooms, and boss arena. Chapter 5 is a dressed variant of this same layout. Separate map segments are the Secret Dream Areas and rare Egg Room, forcing `P4`.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: make all surface, interior, underground, and variant connections authoritative, then dress each chapter’s isometric state from the shared plan.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is large because a few blocks, interiors, rooftops, and underground rooms must remain legible. The theme is cheerful CMY retro-broadcast surrealism decaying into psychological glitch horror. Use `P2` for underground and floating layers, `P3` for enterable buildings and tunnels, and `P4` for isolated secret maps.
